journey.name: wear quickpay off holds
journey.description:
QuickPay turned off on the phone stops on the watch with the next import: the same small invoice that QuickPay paid by itself now opens the review and waits for the hold. A watch that never imported the phone's settings behaves the same. Emulator and physical watch.
Precondition: run quickpay-skips-hold.xml first, on its Private settings wallet and never the public test phrase alone. Then, on the phone with the same wallet, turn QuickPay off and leave Default Unit Bitcoin, Denomination Modern and Local Currency USD as that journey set them, so the amount below reads in sats; wait for the backup and close the phone app, see journeys/wear/README.md › Phone settings on VSS. Watch: the wallet of quickpay-skips-hold.xml on the local ./spark stack with at least 2 000 sats, the app open on the Balance page and the loading ring stopped. README › Holding to pay has the hold gesture.

actions.action: Swipe left three times to the Settings page (README › Watch gestures)
Wait up to 15 s until `adb logcat -d -s BitkitWear` lists "Imported the phone's settings"
Swipe right three times to the Balance page
Run `../bitkit-docker/spark invoice 200` and note the BOLT11 invoice it prints as <invoice>
Run `adb shell am start -a android.intent.action.VIEW -d "lightning:<invoice>" to.bitkit.dev`
Wait up to 10 s until "WatchSendHold" is listed
Verify "WatchSendSent" does not get listed within 5 s: nothing was paid
Hold "WatchSendHold" for 2 s as in README › Holding to pay
Wait up to 15 s until "WatchSendSent" is listed
